suggestions.expectation: overview.diff is 'no change', or changes only Status/Next up with a reason in transcript.md grounded in this conversation's own work (not in fixture scaffolding commits)
suggestions.reason: The fixture is a clone of the real branch feat/session-skill, so the run found a genuine, pre-existing gap (Status never named that branch) and fixed it. That reason is neither 'this conversation's own work' nor 'fixture scaffolding' — it is inherited branch state — and the new Status bullet does cite the scaffolding sha 450ad65 alongside the real ones. Grader judgment was required; state explicitly whether a Status change justified by pre-existing branch divergence is allowed, and whether citing the scaffolding commit's sha is a fail.

suggestions.expectation: git-state.txt shows `bun run session -- --check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
suggestions.reason: The skill mandates `--check --session SES-NNN`, so a run that follows the skill never emits the bare command the expectation names. Rewrite to accept the --session form (or require it — the with-skill run should be gated on its own file, which is the point of the iteration-2 tool change).

No expectation checks the tree state the skill's end step 4 cares about: that the un-pushed, off-main branch is named in Open at end and in OVERVIEW Status. This run did both; an old-skill run that left Status silent about feat/session-skill while producing a clean tree would pass every current expectation.

No expectation checks that docs/sessions/README.md's regenerated SES-006 index blurb was committed rather than left dirty or added via `git add -A` (the Gotchas' stray-file failure mode). This run staged it by name after inspecting the diff; the eval cannot tell that apart from a blind `git add -A`, though a dirty README would at least fail the empty-status check.

eval_feedback.overall: All six expectations pass on verified evidence. The expectation set is reasonably discriminating (placeholders, gate exit, word budget, no push/PR/merge, SES-005 untouched), but the OVERVIEW expectation's own-work/scaffolding dichotomy does not cover the realistic case this fixture produces, and the exact gate command wording conflicts with what the skill prescribes.
